title: Lapis Smp Weapons n Stuff
description: Adds Custom Weapons to any minecraft server but you will see these in the Lapis Smp the most
body:
Lapis SMP: OP Weapons & Structures is a Minecraft mod that adds powerful weapons, unique structures, and exciting new content designed to make survival and SMP gameplay more intense and fun.

⚔️ New OP Weapons

This mod introduces several custom weapons with special abilities, including:
- Dash Sword – Launch forward with a fast dash attack.
- Ban Hammer – A heavy weapon with devastating power.
- Sculk Mace – A dark, sculk-infused mace with strong impact effects.

🏰 New Structures

Explore the world and discover new generated structures that add mystery, loot, and challenges to your adventure.

✨ More Content

- Additional items and features
- Balanced but powerful gameplay for SMP and singleplayer
- Designed for fun, chaos, and exploration

Whether you’re playing on an SMP server or in singleplayer, Lapis SMP brings a fresh and overpowered twist to Minecraft.
